out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed an open cup of coffee being stored on the server/expo countertop next to clean dishes, utensils, and napkins
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. STAFF MOVED THE COFFEE AWAY FROM THE SERVER/EXPO AREA.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: The parasite destruction letters for all of the Raw seafood was not provided.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. CONTACT YOUR SEAFOOD PROVIDER FOR THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER. IF A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER CANNOT BE OBTAIN, DISCONTINUE SELLING THAT PRODUCT. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw shelled eggs was observed over RTE salad 2) containers of various Raw seafoods were observed being stored above poached shrimp
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC AND CHEF TO MOVE ALL COOKED PRODUCTS TO THE COOKED SHELF AND TO KEEP ALL RAW PROTEINS ON THE RAW PROTEIN SHELF. CHEF MOVED THE RAW EGGS AND POACHED SHRIMP ACCORDINGLY Pisco y Nazca Ceviche Gastrobar (Inspection Date: 06/04/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the countertop steam well: lamb shank (93f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE LAMB

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 4DWR 1DR prep top Wok cooler: pork belly (50f), cut tomatoes (55f), Raw steak (45f). Food from this cooler was placed approximately 3 hours prior to inspection 2) in the 4DWR 1DR prep top Fry/Grill cooler: choclo (48f). Choclo was cooked less than 2 hours prior to inspection
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC AND CHEF AGREED TO DISCARD ALL TCS FOODS FROM THE WOK COOLER IN 1 HOUR. CHEF MOVED THE CHOCLO TO THE WALK-IN COOLER TO CHILL TO 41f BEFORE PUTTING ON THE LINE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 4DWR 1DR prep top Wok cooler
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. REPAIR COOLER TO ENSURE FOOD CAN MAINTAIN A TEMPERATURE OF 41f OF LOWER. TEMPORARILY PUT FOOD ON ICE, PREP LESS, AND USE LIDS.

violations.observation: Observed Raw fish being stored over Ready-to-Eat foods in multiple coolers throughout the kitchen.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: Observed no written labels indicated the following foods were to be used or discarded in 4 hours: 1) choclo; 2) Raw shelled eggs; 3) unsalted butter.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS WITH THE TIME IT WAS SET OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED (4 HORUS LATER). EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH AN UPDATED TPHC DOCUMENT TO INCLUDE THE RAW SHELLED EGGS AND UNSALTED BUTTER.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last piece of shellstock from the batch was sold or served was not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WRITE THE DATE IN WHICH THE LAST PIECE OF SHELLSTOCK WAS SOLD ON ITS TAG. ORGANIZE TAGS BY MONTH AND RETAIN FOR 90 DAYS.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The hot water in the high temperature dish machine was observed at 153f on EHS’s high temperature dish plate.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE THE DISH MACHINE TO WASH AND RINSE. SOAK DISHES IN THE SANITIZER IN THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK FOR 30-60 SECONDS. ALLOW TO AIR DRY. PIC WILL CALL FOR A SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR THE MACHINE.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a small bowl sitting in water. Upon discussion, small bowl is used for scooping rice. Observed server scoop deep fried corn kernels with a small serving bowl.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC MOVED THE SMALL BOWL IN WATER TO THE DISH. PIC PLACED A SCOOP WITH A HANDLE NEXT TO THE DEEP FRIED CORN KERNELS.

PURCHASE A HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH PLATE OR HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIPS. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
